ruleDefinitions.name: .RDP File Created By Uncommon Application
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects creation of a file with an ".rdp" extension by an application that doesn't commonly create such files.

sequences.query: (file_path = RGX("\\\.rdp$") AND (process_path = RGX("\\\\brave\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\CCleaner\\ Browser\\\\Application\\\\CCleanerBrowser\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\chromium\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\firefox\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Google\\\\Chrome\\\\Application\\\\chrome\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\iexplore\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\microsoftedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Opera\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Vivaldi\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Whale\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\olk\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Outlook\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\RuntimeBroker\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Thunderbird\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Discord\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Keybase\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msteams\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\Slack\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\teams\\\.exe$")))
